Name: VS Code
Author: hoowan-dev
Description: VS Code shortcuts for the focused window: sidebars, panel, Run and Debug, and Open Recent.

Actions.Name: Toggle Left Sidebar
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles the Primary Side Bar of the focused VS Code window (Ctrl+B).

Actions.Name: Toggle Right Sidebar
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles the Secondary Side Bar of the focused VS Code window (Ctrl+Alt+B).

Actions.Name: Toggle Panel
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles the bottom panel of the focused VS Code window (Ctrl+J).

Actions.Name: Run and Debug
Actions.Tooltip: Starts the selected Run and Debug configuration in the focused VS Code window (F5).

Actions.Name: Open Recent
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a new VS Code window showing your recent workspaces; the one you pick opens there.
